messages:
samir: Heads-up — seeing a ~3.7% delta between invoice-preview and the ledger heartbeat this morning. Preview shows more tokens billed than ledger aggregates. Anyone on the ingestion side?
ellie: hmm, which customer segments? all or specific routes?
samir: mostly bursty tenants and routes with prefix-caching enabled. Looks like the fanout to kafka-partition-agg is delayed causing duplicated ack retries.
devon: can you paste the example event id? might be the dedupe key mismatch we saw last month.
samir: event id: evt_2026_03_21_9a2b. When I grep the raw events I see 2 entries with different fingerprint fields but same client/request id.
maria: billing-bot posted alert: "ledger-heartbeat lag > 5m for partition 3" earlier at 09:04 :warning:
samir: @maria thanks — that alert lines up with the time window for the preview spike.
ellie: quick theory: prefix cache on edge inserts a synthetic token_count for streaming partials, downstream normalizer expects canonical tokenization and dedupe by fingerprint. If fingerprint differs, it double-counts.
devon: agree. also the sample-allocator can reassign priority shards in the same window which produces reordered events; our aggregator is order-dependent.
opsbot: deploy-bot: canary rollout 2026-03-21/edge-normalizer v2 -> 10%
maria: that canary might have touched the aggregator schema (we rolled a field rename). Did we have a compatibility shim?
samir: I see normalizer schema v2 added "token_estimate" and removed "approx_tokens" in the payload. The dedupe key uses approx_tokens currently.
ellie: so when v2 arrives it changes the fingerprint calculation -> duplicates. We need a compat layer: compute fingerprint from a stable key path independent of schema churn.
devon: plus we should add a transient watermark window tolerant to reorders before finalize. Current finalize is immediate on first-seen -> brittle.
maria: for the console UX: invoice-preview shows the higher number and users get confused — can we add an annotation "preview pending reconciliation" when heartbeat lag > 2m?
samir: yes, quick fix for console that doesn't change billing but avoids support noise. I'll raise a tiny flag in the preview pipeline.
ellie: ops notes: steps to remediate: 1) patch normalizer to retain old key for fingerprint for 7 days 2) change aggregator finalize to 30s watermark for reorder tolerance 3) backfill dedupe for the 09:00-09:20 window
devon: I'll open the PR for the watermark change. Samir can you do the shim? Maria can you add the preview annotation?
maria: on it. Also adding a one-time dashboard card in console: "reconciliation events" showing heartbeat lag vs preview delta so support can triage.
opsbot: runbook snippet: ```
# quick triage
kafka-consume --partition 3 --offset 12345 | jq '.fingerprint, .client_id, .token_count'
# check aggregator logs
kubectl logs aggregator-*-patch -n prod | grep evt_2026_03_21_9a2b
```
samir: added a tiny feature flag: preview.reconciliation_note=true for 1h. Deploying now.
maria: PR for console card opened: https://git.internal/redwood/console/pulls/4423
devon: PR for watermark open: https://git.internal/redwood/ingest/pulls/9812 — includes test sim for out-of-order events.
ellie: timeline: patch shim + watermarks + backfill in that order. Backfill should be idempotent.
opsbot: billing-bot: recon job scheduled at 2026-03-21T12:00Z for affected window.
samir: thanks all — once we verify backfill results, we should close the alert and roll the canary up. Also next week we should discuss a unified fingerprint spec in platform-api to avoid ad-hoc key choices.
maria: +1 for spec. Will add to product backlog and schedule a quick doc session.
devon: noted — will include perf impact for larger tenants (watermark increases tail latency).
ellie: fine tradeoff if it avoids invoice deltas and support churn.
samir: closing loop: I'll post a short incident summary into #incidents with a pointer to the PRs + console card once the backfill completes. :thumbsup:
